When you wear a suit and tie, you may feel more put together, professional, and prepared to take on challenges. This can lead to a positive feedback loop, where you feel more confident because you're receiving positive cues from others. It's also worth noting that the psychological impact of wearing a suit and tie can be highly personal and subjective. Some people may feel restricted or uncomfortable in formal attire, while others may feel empowered and confident. Ultimately, it's essential to wear what makes you feel good about yourself and helps you project the image you want to convey. So, if wearing a suit and tie makes you feel confident, that's great!
